newsitem.title: USA: Blackstone unit to buy four U.S. Swissotels.
newsitem.headline: Blackstone unit to buy four U.S. Swissotels.

text.p: SAirRelations, a division of Swissair Schweizerische Luftverkehr AG, said Thursday it agreed to sell four U.S. Swissotel properties, plus a one-quarter interest in Swissotel's U.S. hotel management company, to an affiliate of The Blackstone Group, a privately-held merchant bank.
The sale is expected to close on Aug 1, said the company. Terms were not disclosed.
SAirRelations said Blackstone would purchase Swissotels in New York, Atlanta, Boston and Chicago, and that Swissotel will retain management responsibility for them under a separate agreement.
SAirRelations added that the sale will allow it to pursue new management contracts in the U.S. and globally, as well as providing shareholders with a return on their U.S. investment.
Blackstone Real Estate Partners II LP, the Blackstone affiliate buying the properties, has controlling interests in 40 hotels, valued at over $1.5 billion.
SAirRelations, with $1.8 billion in revenues in 1996, is a unit of the same company that owns Swissair.
